newsitem.title: UK: Bulmer says cider volume grew 4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bulmer says cider volume grew 4 pct in 1996.

text.p: Britain's biggest cider maker HP Bulmer HP Holdings Plc said on Wednesday volume grew by four percent in the year to December 31 and the company would continue to support its brands vigorously.

"We are aware that advertising support for cider overall within the long drinks market has declined and are considering the extent to which it would be right for us to invest more behind our brands to support our growing market share and the industry as a whole," said chief executive John Rudgard, responding to recent talk of a slowdown in growth in the cider industry.
In the year to April 1997 the company spent 29 million stg on marketing investment of which advertising was 4.5 million.
